automationNotes: Doc step 1 says 'Open Studio in your browser (your Studio host, e.g. app.contentstack.com/#!/studio)' — navigates directly to {{STUDIO_HOST_URL}} (CS_APP_ORIGIN + #!/studio) rather than via App Switcher, matching the doc literally. Doc step 3 'Provide a project name' → Name field only; doc never mentions a Description field, so no Description step is included. Doc step 4 'Connect it to your Contentstack stack: pick the stack' is generic (no named field label in the doc), so the flow just searches for the stack control and picks DEFAULT_STACK — no strict label verification against wording the doc doesn't use. Expand Advanced Settings; set Content Type Name and Content Type UID for the compositions content type (DOM: create-new-studio-project-m.html cs-accordion). UID uses {unique25} (lowercase, no spaces). Stack must match DEFAULT_STACK in .env.
